metadata.title: Nvidia’s stock has trailed the broader chip sector this year - MarketWatch

content.text:
1 hour ago
Nvidia’s stock has trailed the broader chip sector this year
Investors have looked beyond Nvidia this year when seeking out ways to ride the artificial-intelligence wave.
Nvidia's stock has trailed the PHLX Semiconductor Index over the course of 2026 to date, rising 14% versus 64% for the broader index.
Shares of Micron Technology, Intel and Advanced Micro Devices have meaningfully outperformed Nvidia's stock on the year. So have shares of chip-equipment makers like Applied Materials. But Nvidia's stock has beaten out Broadcom's, which is up just 3% so far in 2026.
